training_stack: mjlab 1.3.0 (MuJoCo Warp), PPO via RSL-RL, trained with pollen-robotics/microduck_rl (fork dillonfaulk/microduck_rl)

training.gpu: GPU0 only, peak ~6.5 GB used by the run (7.6 GB on the card incl. ~1.1 GB display)
training.robot_model: groundcontact (as upstream); evaluated on the all-collisions robot
training.reward_signs: every penalty term <= 0 on every readout, iterations 0-1999

contract.obs_layout: same as VelStand: ang_vel 0:3, projected_gravity 3:6, joint_pos_rel 6:20, joint_vel 20:34, last_action 34:48, command 48:61 (all zero during the kick)
contract.obs_normalization: empirical normalizer BAKED INTO the ONNX (exported with scripts/export.py) -- feed raw observations
contract.use: hard swap from VelStand / PrecisionStep with the ball at (0.09, +0.042) m in the trunk yaw frame; hold 2 s; swap VelStand back

measured_results_model_1250.battery_50: 50/50 good kicks (kicked and standing); peak ball speed 0.36 m/s median = 1.4x target
measured_results_model_1250.prestand_handoff_50: 50/50 (1.5 s VelStand stand -> kick -> VelStand at 2 s); peak 0.41 m/s = 1.6x
measured_results_model_1250.missions_uncalibrated_2x30: 60/60 kicked, 0 bumps, 0 falls, precision mode 60/60; roll 1.19 m; kick direction -11.2 deg median (RIGHT of intended), std 1.3, flat across ball distance
measured_results_model_1250.missions_calibrated_2x30: 60/60 kicked, 0 bumps, 0 falls; kick direction -0.2 deg median (-3.5..+3.6); roll 1.21 m; peak 0.44 m/s
measured_results_model_1250.missions_viewer_30: Dillon's live viewer run: 30/30 kicked, all precision, 0 falls; kick direction -0.5 deg median (-6..+3), 26/30 within 2 deg; roll 1.26 m median (0.96-1.46); peak 0.45 m/s
measured_results_model_1250.stay_up_rate: 100% in every battery and mission at 1250 (no falls)

checkpoint_choice: 1250 over 1000 (also 60/60): tighter drift (std 1.3 vs 1.9), 50/50 in every battery. Overfits later like the right foot: missions 60/60 at 1500, 55/60 at 1750, 42/60 at 1999 (battery still 49-50/50)

mission_calibrations.note: supervisor constants in kick_mission.py, --foot left; measured against THIS checkpoint, no right-foot reuse (right keeps +10 mm / -17.9 deg)

PRECISE_STANCE_SHIFT_M_left.why: unshifted the ball sits +9.4 mm far of the kick spot from the left foot but already rolls 1.19 m; +9 mm tested and REJECTED: 58/60, 2 bumps (PrecisionStep's stepping foot clipped the ball; it trained with the ball on the right side only)

KICK_AIM_OFFSET_left.sign: +yaw is LEFT; this kick drifts RIGHT (-11.2 deg), so the offset is positive (aim left)

known_weaknesses: SIM ONLY -- never run on the physical robot
kicks drift ~11 deg RIGHT of the intended line (mirror of the right foot's ~18 deg left, smaller); compensated by the mission's +11.2 deg aim offset
too strong: ~0.41-0.45 m/s in missions vs the 0.25 m/s target (1.6-1.8x; right foot ~1.6x)
ball sits ~9 mm farther than trained from the left foot (no stance shift: a shift made PrecisionStep bump a left-side ball)
narrow start-stance tolerance in later checkpoints (overfit after 1500)
ground-truth pose and ball position in sim
